testcases.expected:
- Live site and members.js list exactly the same members
- Every member is listed with a grade, and their card, member page and badge all show the same grade
- No script errors on any member page
- Last verified Oct 10, 2026: all 540 runs passed in 4.7 minutes (local build)
testcases.risk: Catches data or build errors that affect individual members (a wrong grade, a missing page or badge, a member dropped from the roster) that the 16 feature tests would never see.
testcases.steps:
Automated as TC-17 in tests/every-member.spec.js. Data-driven: runs once per member listed in site/data/members.js (539 members as of the Oct 10, 2026 data) plus one roster check, so 540 runs, Chromium only. Each test is named "<ID> <Name> (<Chamber>, <State>)".
1. Roster check (TC-17.00): compare member IDs on the live home page with members.js.
2. Per member: find the member on the home page and confirm a grade.
3. Open their card: name, grade, 3 subjects, Congress.gov link, link to members/<ID>.html. Press Escape to close.
4. Open /members/<ID>.html (HTTP 200).
5. Check the member page: name, grade matches home page, title, summary, 3 subjects, canonical link, Congress.gov link, no script errors.
6. Fetch /badges/<ID>.svg and confirm the same grade.
Steps 2 to 6 use soft checks so one run reports every mismatch for that member.
testcases.title: Every member of Congress (data-driven, 540 runs)
